arena: [생존기] Unending Resolve reduces all damage taken by 25% for 8 sec and makes you immune to interrupts and silences. Pop it when you need to land the 3 sec Chaos Bolt cast uninterrupted or when enemy burst cooldowns pile up.
[생존기] Dark Pact can be used while CC'd; it sacrifices 20% of your current health to grant a shield worth more than twice that for 20 sec. Press it immediately when you take burst while stunned.

[회피] Place Demonic Circle behind a pillar and teleport back to it to remove all slows. With Impish Instincts, each time you take direct physical damage its cooldown drops by 3 sec. When melee DPS get on you, teleport and break line of sight.
[생존기] With Nether Ward, all harmful spells cast at you are reflected for 3 sec. Pop it right before an enemy caster's CC cast finishes.
[차단] Your Felhunter's Spell Lock interrupts a cast and locks that school for 7 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[우선 처치] With Fel Fissure, a 5 yd fissure under your Chaos Bolt target slows enemies by 50% and reduces healing taken by 25% for 6 sec. Focus Chaos Bolt on your kill target.
[제어] Fear disorients the target for 20 sec but damage can break it. Put it on the enemy healer and have your team attack another target.
[제어] Howl of Terror makes up to 5 enemies within 10 yds flee in fear for 20 sec but damage can break it. Peel melee DPS on you and create casting distance.
bg: [참고] Pet classes are good at base defense. On defense, place Demonic Circle away from the base flag; with Shadow Rift, enemy players in the rift are moved to your Demonic Circle after 2 sec. Pull enemies coming to capture off the flag.

[분담] Gateway Mastery was picked by 21 of 36 Battleground Blitz players. It increases Demonic Gateway's range by 20 yds and reduces the reuse delay for the same person by 30 sec. Move your team toward a distant base under attack or your carrier.
[생존기] Nether Ward was picked by 31 of 36 Battleground Blitz players and reflects all harmful spells for 3 sec. Pop it when multiple enemies are casting CC at you.
[제어] Enemies feared by Howl of Terror can't be knocked back. Use it on several enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.

[우선 처치] Fel Fissure was picked by 25 of 36 Battleground Blitz players. The fissure under your Chaos Bolt target slows enemies by 50% and reduces healing taken by 25%, so land Chaos Bolt on the enemy flag or orb carrier.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Dark Pact's shield and Unending Resolve right before the burst.
